SELECT s.shipment_id,
( SELECT a.gateway_id
FROM shipment_device_assignments a
WHERE a.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
ORDER BY a.assigned_at DESC, a.assignment_id DESC
LIMIT 1 ) AS gateway_id,
s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location,
s.departure_latitude, s.departure_longitude,
s.destination_latitude, s.destination_longitude,
s.vehicle_number, s.driver_name, s.driver_phone,
s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at,
r.temp_min_c AS temp_min, r.temp_max_c AS temp_max, r.temp_hold_seconds, r.shock_threshold_g
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN judgement_rules r ON s.rule_id = r.rule_id
WHERE s.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.logger_id)
r.logger_id, r.measured_at, r.temperature, r.humidity,
ROUND(r.battery_pct)::INTEGER AS battery_pct
FROM readings r
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
FROM shipment_device_assignments a
WHERE a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
AND a.gateway_id = r.gateway_id
AND ( a.logger_id IS NULL OR a.logger_id = r.logger_id )
AND r.measured_at >= a.assigned_at
AND ( a.unassigned_at IS NULL OR r.measured_at <= a.unassigned_at ) )
AND r.measured_at >= #{startedAt}
AND r.measured_at <= #{endedAt}
ORDER BY r.logger_id, r.measured_at DESC, r.reading_id DESC

SELECT alert_id, logger_id, alert_type AS type, detected_at AS occurred_at, extreme_value, threshold_value
FROM alerts
WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
ORDER BY detected_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.measured_at)
r.measured_at, r.latitude, r.longitude
FROM readings r
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1
FROM shipment_device_assignments a
WHERE a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
AND a.gateway_id = r.gateway_id
AND ( a.logger_id IS NULL OR a.logger_id = r.logger_id )
AND r.measured_at >= a.assigned_at
AND ( a.unassigned_at IS NULL OR r.measured_at <= a.unassigned_at ) )
AND r.measured_at >= #{startedAt}
AND r.measured_at <= #{endedAt}
AND r.latitude IS NOT NULL
AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.measured_at ASC, r.reading_id DESC

SELECT a.alert_id, a.alert_type, a.logger_id, a.detected_at, a.extreme_value, a.threshold_value,
r.latitude, r.longitude
FROM alerts a
JOIN readings r ON r.reading_id = a.trigger_reading_id
WHERE a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
AND r.latitude IS NOT NULL
AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.detected_at ASC

SELECT s.shipment_id,
( SELECT a.gateway_id
FROM shipment_device_assignments a
WHERE a.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
ORDER BY a.assigned_at DESC, a.assignment_id DESC
LIMIT 1 ) AS gateway_id,
s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location, s.vehicle_number,
s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.created_at,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM alerts a
WHERE a.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
AND a.alert_type IN ( 'TEMP_HIGH', 'TEMP_LOW' )
) AS temp_deviation_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM alerts a
WHERE a.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
AND a.alert_type = 'SHOCK'
) AS shock_count
FROM shipments s
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.shipment_id DESC
LIMIT 50
SELECT rule_id, rule_name FROM judgement_rules WHERE enabled = 'Y' ORDER BY rule_id

SELECT s.shipment_id, a.gateway_id, s.cargo_name, s.departure_location, s.destination_location, s.planned_departure_at, s.driver_phone
FROM shipment_device_assignments a
JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = a.shipment_id
WHERE a.gateway_id = #{gatewayId}
AND a.unassigned_at IS NULL
ORDER BY a.assigned_at DESC, a.assignment_id DESC
LIMIT 1
